target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one guest CPU, current desktop ISO
command: ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-mpradix-current.log QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-source-fast --probe-source-module disk:/Demo/MultiCore/MPRadix.ZC --probe-source tests/compat/MultiCore1Runtime.ZC --probe-source-call MultiCore1RuntimeAcceptance
verified: The current bundled MPRadix adaptation ran QuickSort, QuickSortU32, and its one-worker radix stage on the guest's single CPU.
All three dumps contained the same sorted sample bytes.
The cooperative worker regression returned 0x2a after its internal checks for Spawn, Yield, aggregation and completion.
remaining: The guest still exposes only one logical CPU, so no multi-CPU radix distribution or parallel speedup has been demonstrated. Preserve partial status until the AArch64 guest has real SMP scheduling and that path passes. This is not evidence of a stock-source algorithm defect.
scope_note: Current-image runtime acceptance for the cooperative single-worker fallback only; not SMP, live UTM UI, or physical Pi acceptance.
